concept.title: People keeping fit and active
concept.shortdesc: People of any fitness level who want to walk, run, cycle or start or return to exercise.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People joining walking groups, described by walking fitness or aids used.
: Sessions open to people at any level of fitness or ability, from beginner to advanced.
: People who are new to exercise, out of practice or wanting to keep fit and active.
: People who run, cycle or swim, from beginners to seasoned competitors.
